Open the mortality review in a browser

Source: R/review_mortality.R
review_mortality.Rd

Opens the review index in dir with utils::browseURL(), or builds the cards and index first with build_mortality_cards(). It builds when bands is given, or when dir holds no index.html yet; with no bands, a first build uses detect_mortality() at its default rules, and a message says so.

Usage

review_mortality(
  x,
  dir,
  bands = NULL,
  all = FALSE,
  open = interactive(),
  control = list()
)

Arguments

x

The detset.

dir

Folder that holds, or will hold, index.html.

bands

Optional result of detect_mortality(). When given, the cards and index are written again.

all

Passed to build_mortality_cards(): TRUE writes a card for the alive band too.

open

If FALSE, the page is not opened.

control

Passed to build_mortality_cards(): title, store, outline and cores.

Value

x, invisibly, with a log record. When the review was built, x

carries the build's record and x$cards, whose attribute index

holds the path of index.html; when an existing review was opened, the record of review_mortality says so.

Details

review_mortality() does not rebuild an existing review unless bands is given. When the index in dir was built from other detections, carries no key of its detections, or lacks the alive-band cards that all = TRUE asks for, and no bands are given, review_mortality() stops and names the call that rebuilds it with the rules you chose. Calls made in the browser are kept through a rebuild in the same folder. The page and the cards are static files: no R session runs behind them, and they can be sent to a co-author who has no R. Calls made in the browser stay in that browser until they are exported as CSV.

Examples

study <- detqc_example
dets <- detset(study$detections, study$deployments, study$animals)
dets <- review_mortality(dets, file.path(tempdir(), "review_open"), open = FALSE)
#> Building the review in the folder "review_open" at the default rules of
#> detect_mortality(); give `bands` to use your own.
basename(attr(dets$cards, "index"))
#> [1] "index.html"
